responsibility: This option-definition file declares the D frontend’s command-line options to GCC’s option generator. It describes D-specific flags, aliases, option variables, enums, diagnostics, and driver-only switches for imports, documentation/interface/JSON output, runtime and contract controls, preview/revert language features, warning groups, template/link behavior, and libphobos-related driver options, forming the authoritative source for generated option parsing tables and help text.
